question:
The pie chart given here shows the spending by a family on various items during the year 1999. Study the graph and answer these questions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/695bafd9f72351de2446f407ec3d752da2164d2db74bc93566f8824b2be1d0ef.png] 

If the total amount spent during the year 1999 was Rs. 46,000, the amount spent on food was:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total amount spent during the year 1999 was Rs. 46,000,

The amount spent on food was 23%

So value of 23% will be 46000 × 23/100 = Rs. 10,580

**∴ The correct option is** **1**
